verdict.rationale: Pipedrive documents an official MCP server that lets an AI assistant update records and move opportunities through the pipeline. A documented REST API (v1/v2, OpenAPI specs, deal endpoints) gives a programmatic route for the same deal updates, so the core of the story is delivered. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of updating next steps/activities via the agent, any documented way to ingest email or meeting signals into those updates, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven stage changes.
